source: Existing H1 signal-quality ablation results; 50 symbols, 12 parameter combinations, 3 chronological folds; Binance OHLCV proxy and modeled costs.
ranking_method: Robust screening score using median per-symbol-run net PnL, positive run percentage, median profit factor, inverse median drawdown, number of parameter configurations positive in all three folds, and number positive in the final fold. This is a research shortlist, not a profitability claim.
caution: The same historical archive has already been inspected during screening; selected-universe reruns are focused validation, not an independent blind holdout. Require future untouched data and realistic Bybit fills before production.
